extraction.notes: Government bill and explanatory statement, PZ 528, sent to the Croatian Parliament. Screened by keyword for citizenship and EEA provisions; the explanation of bill Article 56 (pages 72-73) read in full. Text-file page numbers are PDF page numbers. Only claims on access to employment for EU workers in Croatia were extracted (RI-FMW-001, LIM-0026). Pass 1 does not assign issues. The public consultation annex (from about page 96) includes comments on foreign nationals, but much of its text is garbled in conversion because of the PDF’s fonts, so it was not extracted; the report table there would need a visual check. The passage in the explanation on practice in other Member States was left out as about other countries. Each quote is machine translated. Quotes keep the stray spaces of the converted text.

items.stated_text: Propisuje se mogućnost prijma u državnu službu državljanina države članice Europskog gospodarskog prostora ili Švicarske Konfederacije , koji zna hrvatski jezik i latinično pismo , i državljanina treće zemlje (državljanina države koja nije članica Europsk og gospodarskog prostora i Švicarske Konfederacije ili osobe bez državljanstva), uz prethodno odobrenje tijela državne uprave nadležnog za službeničke odnose, ako zna hrvatski jezik i latinično pismo i ima odobren boravak na temelju kojeg mogu raditi bez dozvole za boravak i rad, sukladno posebnom zakonu.
items.translation_en: The possibility is provided of admitting to the civil service a national of a Member State of the European Economic Area or of the Swiss Confederation who knows the Croatian language and the Latin script, and a third-country national (a national of a state not a member of the European Economic Area and the Swiss Confederation, or a stateless person), with the prior approval of the state administration body competent for civil service relations, if he knows the Croatian language and the Latin script and has an approved stay on the basis of which he may work without a stay and work permit, in accordance with a special law.
items.summary: The bill allows admission of EEA or Swiss nationals who know Croatian and Latin script, and third-country nationals with prior approval.

subjects.name_as_stated: državljanina države članice Europskog gospodarskog prostora

items.stated_text: Navedene osobe ne mogu se primiti na poslove iz članka 4. stavka 2. ovoga Zakona (poslovi iz djelokruga državnog tijela utvrđene Ustavom, zakonom ili drugim propisima donesenim na temelju Ustava i zakona ) niti se tijekom službe mogu premjestiti odnosno rasporediti na te poslove. To znači da se navedeni mogu primiti u državnu službu samo na poslove državnih službenika iz članka 4. stavka 3. o voga Zakona (na informatičke, opće, administrativne, računovodstvene i druge slične poslove).
items.translation_en: The said persons may not be admitted to the duties referred to in Article 4 paragraph 2 of this Act (duties within the remit of a state body determined by the Constitution, law or other regulations adopted on the basis of the Constitution and law), nor may they during service be transferred or assigned to those duties. This means that the said persons may be admitted to the civil service only for the duties of civil servants referred to in Article 4 paragraph 3 of this Act (IT, general, administrative, accounting and other similar duties).
items.summary: These persons cannot be admitted or moved to duties within a state body’s remit; only IT, general, administrative, accounting and similar civil servant posts.

items.stated_text: Stoga se u skladu s ranije navedenim propisima Europske unije i praksom drugih država članica Europske unije usklađuje i naše zakonodavstvo.
items.translation_en: Therefore, in accordance with the previously mentioned European Union provisions and the practice of other European Union Member States, our legislation is also being aligned.
items.summary: The Government states that it is therefore aligning Croatian legislation with those EU provisions and the practice of other Member States.
